data.content_ref: inline:Relation Kind: Integration (Hybrid Selection System). The problem proposes an integration relation where modern science is a hybrid system combining biological-style blind variation (creative conjecture) with a uniquely human normative filter (critical rationality), creating a new emergent mechanism distinct from both parents. Refuted If: It is demonstrated that 'critical rationality' is itself an evolved biological trait subject to the same blind selection pressures, meaning there is no second filter to integrate, only a single continuous evolutionary process.
